This helper file generates two animated GIFs for Lecture 31:

1. a cubic-spline animation showing `df = 4, 5, 8, 10`
2. a LOESS animation showing `span = 0.15, 0.30, 0.45, 0.60`

The code looks for the course repository root, reads `data/seoul_bike_hourly.csv`,
and writes the GIFs to `figures/lecture31/`.

```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(splines)
library(gifski)

find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

  repeat {
    has_data <- file.exists(file.path(current, "data", "seoul_bike_hourly.csv"))
    has_lecture <- file.exists(file.path(current, "lecture-content", "31-splines-loess.Rmd"))

    if (has_data && has_lecture) {
      return(current)
    }

    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop(
        "Could not find the 161251 repository root. Render this file from somewhere inside the repo."
      )
    }

    current <- parent
  }
}

repo_root <- find_repo_root()
data_path <- file.path(repo_root, "data", "seoul_bike_hourly.csv")
out_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "figures", "lecture31")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

gif_width <- 900
gif_height <- 540
gif_delay <- 1.2

seoul_temp <- read_csv(data_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(temperature, rented_bike_count) |>
  filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(rented_bike_count))

temp_grid <- tibble(
  temperature = seq(
    min(seoul_temp$temperature),
    max(seoul_temp$temperature),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

y_limits <- range(seoul_temp$rented_bike_count)

spline_dfs <- c(4, 5, 8, 10)
loess_spans <- c(0.15, 0.30, 0.45, 0.60)
```

## Precompute fitted values

```{r precompute}
spline_predictions <- map_dfr(spline_dfs, function(df_value) {
  fit <- lm(rented_bike_count ~ bs(temperature, df = df_value), data = seoul_temp)
  spline_terms <- bs(seoul_temp$temperature, df = df_value)
  knots <- attr(spline_terms, "knots")

  tibble(
    df = df_value,
    temperature = temp_grid$temperature,
    fitted = predict(fit, newdata = temp_grid),
    knots = list(knots)
  )
})

loess_predictions <- map_dfr(loess_spans, function(span_value) {
  fit <- loess(
    rented_bike_count ~ temperature,
    data = seoul_temp,
    span = span_value,
    degree = 2,
    control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
  )

  tibble(
    span = span_value,
    temperature = temp_grid$temperature,
    fitted = predict(fit, newdata = temp_grid)
  )
})

y_limits[2] <- max(
  y_limits[2],
  spline_predictions$fitted,
  loess_predictions$fitted,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```

## Plot helpers

```{r plot-helpers}
make_spline_plot <- function(df_value) {
  frame_data <- filter(spline_predictions, df == df_value)
  knot_values <- frame_data$knots[[1]]

  ggplot(seoul_temp, aes(x = temperature, y = rented_bike_count)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.45) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = knot_values,
      colour = "grey45",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = frame_data,
      aes(y = fitted),
      colour = "blue3",
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    labs(
      x = "Temperature (°C)",
      y = "Hourly rented bike count",
      title = sprintf("Cubic spline with df = %s", df_value),
      subtitle = sprintf(
        "%s internal knot%s shown with dashed lines",
        length(knot_values),
        if (length(knot_values) == 1) "" else "s"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}

make_loess_plot <- function(span_value) {
  frame_data <- filter(loess_predictions, span == span_value)

  ggplot(seoul_temp, aes(x = temperature, y = rented_bike_count)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.05, size = 0.45) +
    geom_line(
      data = frame_data,
      aes(y = fitted),
      colour = "forestgreen",
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    labs(
      x = "Temperature (°C)",
      y = "Hourly rented bike count",
      title = sprintf("LOESS with span = %.2f", span_value),
      subtitle = if (span_value < 0.3) {
        "Smaller span: more local and more wiggly"
      } else if (span_value < 0.5) {
        "Middle span: balances local detail and smoothness"
      } else {
        "Larger span: smoother, with more borrowing from farther away"
      }
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
}
```

## Animation helper

```{r animation-helper}
make_gif <- function(values, plot_fun, stem, delay = gif_delay,
                     width = gif_width, height = gif_height) {
  frame_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0(stem, "_frames"))
  dir.create(frame_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  frame_paths <- map2_chr(values, seq_along(values), function(value, i) {
    frame_path <- file.path(frame_dir, sprintf("%s_%02d.png", stem, i))

    ggsave(
      filename = frame_path,
      plot = plot_fun(value),
      width = width / 100,
      height = height / 100,
      units = "in",
      dpi = 100
    )

    frame_path
  })

  frame_paths <- c(frame_paths, rep(tail(frame_paths, 1), 2))
  gif_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(stem, ".gif"))

  gifski(
    png_files = frame_paths,
    gif_file = gif_path,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    delay = delay,
    loop = TRUE
  )

  gif_path
}
```

## Build the GIFs

```{r build-gifs}
spline_gif <- make_gif(
  values = spline_dfs,
  plot_fun = make_spline_plot,
  stem = "cubic-spline-df"
)

loess_gif <- make_gif(
  values = loess_spans,
  plot_fun = make_loess_plot,
  stem = "loess-span"
)

cat("Saved GIFs to:\n")
cat("- ", spline_gif, "\n", sep = "")
cat("- ", loess_gif, "\n", sep = "")
```

## Preview the GIFs

```{r preview-spline, echo=FALSE, out.width='95%'}
knitr::include_graphics(spline_gif)
```

```{r preview-loess, echo=FALSE, out.width='95%'}

```
